A little about me

Curious by nature.
Builder by habit.

Hi, I’m Sanjana. I’m a computer science student who likes learning by building. My projects take me across cybersecurity, AI and data, robotics, and full-stack web development—from a lab-scale OT security simulation to practical tools for people and teams.

I enjoy understanding how the pieces fit together, trying ideas hands-on, and making the result easier for someone else to use.

WaterGuard — local OT IDS/IPS simulation

A controlled lab prototype that checks commands before they reach a simulated water-control device. It combines source and freshness checks, HMAC-SHA256 authentication, register and safety rules, and tamper-evident encrypted decision records.
